src: middle solid rectangular object between two end objects
path: straight horizontal or vertical line away from the non-target end object and through the perpendicular solid target rectangle/bar
dst: place flush with the grid edge beyond the target
trajectory: paint only the final moved rectangle at dst
transform: erase original source pixels; split the target rectangle/bar along the moving object's two-cell-wide path and shift its two halves one cell outward perpendicular to the movement; keep the other end object unchanged
